title: Primer of the Throwing Board
summary: Teaches a first-time student how to hold the throwing board, seat a dart on its spur and cast it flat.

title: Drill-Book of the Dart Quiver
summary: Drills the belted quiver, the clean draw of a dart and the quick reload that keeps a thrower casting.

title: A Beginner's Handbook of Spur and Shaft
summary: Shows a beginner how to inspect spur and shaft, hold the loops lightly and throw a short snapping cast.

title: Workbook of the Overarm Cast
summary: Builds the high overarm cast from the hips up, with wind reading and pacing so darts drop onto a distant mark.

title: Plain Rules for Straw-Target Practice
summary: Sets out daily practice against a bundled straw mark to train steady eyes, repeating arms and tight groups.

title: Treatise on Even Flight
summary: Adds a thread of circulating qi to the cast so the dart flies level, spins true and is followed in the air.

title: Field Canon of the Spur-Seat
summary: Teaches how to seat darts on the spur under pressure, on bad ground, and drive them out with a crisp snap.

title: Handbook of the Thrower's Loop Grip
summary: Explains the finger loops of the board, how to thread them, brace the hand with qi and release cleanly.

title: Primer of Light-Dart Casting
summary: Teaches the choice and casting of light, quick darts for rapid fire, flushing cover and skirmishing on the move.

title: The Hunter's Sidearm Workbook
summary: Covers the low sidearm cast of a hunter, with stalking, reading of game tracks and shooting from brush.
